function.description: **NETWORK SERVER SETTINGS** : Retrieve NTP settings for a site. For broad queries such as what network server settings are configured at a site, invoke this tool together with the AAA, DHCP, DNS, image distribution, time zone, and banner settings tools to build a complete network server settings response. Use this tool for generic site-level NTP configuration queries, including the configured NTP servers, inherited NTP settings, and the parent site from which NTP settings are inherited. Example queries include: Which NTP servers are configured for a site? Are NTP settings for a site inherited? From which parent site? `null` values indicate that the setting will be inherited from the parent site; empty objects (`{}`) indicate that the setting is unset at a site.
function.name: api_retrieveNTPSettingsForASite

_inherited.description: Include inherited NTP settings from parent sites.

servers.description: NTP servers to facilitate system clock synchronization for your network.
